The '''Xelric Draw''' was a shallow, wide-mouthed canyon on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It split the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]] at the western edge of the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]]. It was an ancient trading route that connected the northern settlements with the southern settlements. Outside the draw, lawlessness and hostility would prevail in settlements.<ref name="ItWoSWE1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] once sheltered a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] and raced there. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] freighter [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']], which crashed near the Xelric Draw, was picked clean by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] tribes.

[[File:EncounterintheDesert.png|thumb|left|200px|Duel in Xelric Draw]]

Xelric Draw was the landing site of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was also the place of the [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|duel]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
